Resolves #21451

🧭 *Setting `denseUpdate = true` in `grid.header.Toolbar#afterSetSortable` and `grid.Body#updateCellPositions` ships every header and rendered row whole when a single child's own reactive update merges into the same render cycle.*

Evidence: L2 (Playwright single-thread VDOM/vnode unit suite asserting rendered vnode classes and cell geometry across merged cycles) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: bounded-bugfix — 2 `me.denseUpdate = true` lines restoring the existing `VdomLifecycle#denseUpdate` contract (`#21449`, `#19402`, `#19404`), plus JSDoc and 2 red-to-green vnode unit specs.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/grid/DenseUpdateMergedChild.spec.mjs` › toggles `headerToolbar.sortable` in the same pass as `cityButton.text = 'Town'` and verifies every header's `vnode.className` carries (and on re-enable drops) `neo-sort-hidden` |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/grid/DenseUpdateMergedChild.spec.mjs` › runs `body.updateCellPositions('name', 333)` in the same pass as `store.get(3).city = 'Changed'` and verifies every rendered row's `vnode` cell carries `width: 333px` and neighbour `left: 413px` |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderButtonSortable.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/grid/ColumnResizeCellSync.spec.mjs` (`531/531` `test/playwright/unit/grid/` specs passing) |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `npm run test-unit` (`unit` CI job) |
